topic: Report data clarification and design updates
summary_markdown: A new report was deployed to staging. The sender noted that frequency tracking was omitted because it can be easily calculated by dividing traffic or footfall by unique users. Confusion exists regarding the definition and display of different impression types (specifically, those related to 'Vlad' versus previous impressions). The sender offered to add this data but requested clarification on how to name and present these metrics to prevent client confusion. Regarding design, the sender suggested duplicating a specific element near the report options, referencing its previous placement.
decisions: The location for impression data is confirmed to be within the frames.
action_items: Someone will ask 'Vlad' to provide clarification on the impression metric.
Implement design change by duplicating an element near report options.
